patches_required.summary: Verifier subgoal diagnoses now include exact expected content and a bounded JSON-escaped preview for unexpected expected-content mismatches.
Stuckness safe-stop is deferred once when a newly diagnosed unexpected-file-content mismatch exposes exact expected bytes, allowing one additional live-model repair step.
The live decision prompt now includes an explicit exact verifier repair directive telling the model not to paraphrase, pretty-print, or alter spacing.

interpretation.positive: The existing queue and manifest path completed a harder hintless held-out rotation under live vLLM after verifier-aligned repair feedback was made explicit.
interpretation.limit: This is strong A7-readiness evidence, not a full A7 crossing by itself. It covers five hard frontier tasks, not broad unfamiliar-domain transfer at scale or strong-human-level performance.
interpretation.next_shortest_step: Fold r1/r2/r3-hard into one A7 readiness packet, then either repeat the hard hintless rotation under model-stack or run a larger hard held-out rotation with the same exact-repair instrumentation.
